_about: Embraer EMB-145, APM-145/1100 Rev 16, Figure 2.2.1: page index 19, layers.py --mode strokes --color 0,0,0 at scale 16, clip 65,235,475,510 (plan). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half (the aircraft's right side; the left side's main door is drawn on the lower half, the right side's service door on the upper, as Figure 2.7.1 puts them). From the stub pylon's leading edge back, the fuselage's side is under the pylon: the line inboard of it is where the pylon's top meets the fuselage, so the width is bridged to where the side shows again behind the pylon's trailing edge. The tail cone's end is under the tailplane: bridged to it (free). Plain wing tip. The tailplane's leading edge runs on along its raked tip to the trailing corner (the tip is furthest out there).
